question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given bracketed word.

She (woke up) and realized she had no recollection of the past several hours.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"woke up"** means to stop sleeping and become conscious or alert. (जागना)

 
 
• **Example: **She** woke up** early to catch the first train.
 
 
 
• **"Awakened"** refers to the act of waking up from sleep or causing someone to become aware of something. (जागृत)
 
 
• **Example: **He was suddenly **awakened** by a loud noise in the middle of the night.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **"woke up"** is **"awakened"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Moved** (हिला): To change position or place.

 
 
• **Example:** She moved the chair closer to the window.
 
 
 
• **Activated** (सक्रिय किया): To make something active or operative.
 
 
• **Example:** The alarm is activated when someone tries to break in.
 
 
 
• **Challenged** (चुनौती दी): To invite someone to engage in a contest or competition.
 
 
• **Example:** He challenged his friend to a game of chess.
 
 

31:Tc13,

The correct answer is: Option 1<
